newsitem.title: USA: Family Bargain December sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Family Bargain December sales rise.

text.p: Family Bargain Corp said its total December sales rose 16 percent to $43.1 million from $37.3 million last December, and its same store sales for the month rose six percent.
Year-to-date sales through December rose to $237.5 million from $170.2 million, and same store year-to-date sales were up six percent.
Sales for December 1996 as well as December 1995 include sales from the Factory 2-U stores that were acquired in November 1995.
